description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Order to acquire the land in Bloemendhal, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land matters, specifically the vesting of a specific parcel of land (described in detail with boundaries, extent, and lot numbers) to the Urban Development Authority. While it names a Minister and his portfolio, the core content is about a land transfer and property description, making it a Land Gazette. The government personnel mention is incidental to the primary land-related action.
